chapter_title: The Chapter of the Commandments of Righteousness
chapter_note: This chapter is overwhelmingly institutional/disciplinary (elect vs. catechumens; fasting, prayer, alms; prohibitions; donations to the church). Even where Manichaean cosmological terms appear (Cross of Light; sun and moon as light-givers), they function as practical piety and community regulation rather than impersonal cosmos→cosmos correspondential exposition. The strong editorial-fatigue drift and the seam-flagged final paragraph reinforce a late pastoral compilation with no recoverable pre-compilation substrate in these paragraphs.

paragraphs.temporal_note: Opens with a clear hagiographic/dialogue frame formula (“[Once more] the enlightener speaks to his disciples”), but the substance is disciplinary: three-part righteousness (continence; ‘rest of the hands’ re: Cross of Light; purity of mouth abstaining from meat/wine). This is church praxis (the ‘seals’) rather than systematic cosmological mapping.

Moral/exhortative righteousness content (increasing wisdom/faith/grace; edifying others) without cosmological mechanics or internal cosmic correspondences; reads as paraenetic instruction for community life.
Explicit institutional categories and staged perfection (“elect” vs “catechumen of the faith”); this is community structuring rather than substrate teaching.

Catechumenal rule-list (fasting/prayer/almsgiving) with explicitly Christian calendrical language (“lord's day”) and institutional almsgiving. ‘Pray to the sun and the moon’ is cosmological vocabulary serving liturgical instruction, not an impersonal exposition of cosmic structure.
Church-directed social/household regulations (giving a child/relative/slave ‘to the church’; sharing in merits). Cosmos→institution mapping; firmly pastoral.
Institutional benefaction instruction (“build a dwelling… portion of alms in the holy church”); not substrate.

Seam-flagged editorial extension: summarizes/expands catechumenal ‘three great works/alms’ and promises ‘grace and good in the holy church.’ Strong institutional vocabulary and list-extension closure; no recoverable core layer here.
